The '''Rendili Vehicle Corporation''' was a business structure owned and operated by the [[Rendili Vehicle Corporation/Legends|company of the same name]]. Located on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], the facility functioned as an corporate office building, a lab, a testing facility, and the location of a design department. During the [[Great Galactic War]] the facility was visited by [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Hylo Visz]], who was delivering experimental [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engines]] on behalf of [[Barrga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. Rendili decided to double-cross the Hutt, and so wired the smuggler's payment with explosives. Her ship was destroyed as a result, but the Corporation was still successful in gaining the ion drives.

During this time, the Rendili Corporation was working on several contracts from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], with the ion engine project being one of them. The facility also housed the [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|Vanguard project]]&mdash;an initiative to build an advanced [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Although a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] representative was slated to take the Vanguard on a test-flight, Hylo Visz, who survived the attempted murder, commandeered the vessel and escaped the Rendili facility.
